title: Moroccan Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious stir fry with the bold flavors of Moroccan cuisine. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: tender
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers or zucchini

ingredients.name: moroccan
ingredients.notes: such as ras el hanout spice blend

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the tender ingredients and cook until they start to soften, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the energizing ingredients and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the sour ingredient and cook for another minute.
Season with the moroccan ingredient and serve hot.
